systems.name: Gradle build
systems.function: Build, test and publish every module from one place: the wrapper, the settings, and the included build-logic build whose convention plugins give each module its Kotlin setup at the Java 11 floor and the verifyJavaFloor guard, its seven package-selected level test tasks and the Maven Central publishing skeleton.
systems.toolchain: Gradle 9.7.1 · Kotlin 2.2.0 · Java floor 11 · vanniktech maven-publish 0.36.0 · binary-compatibility-validator 0.18.2 · foojay 0.8.0

systems.name: check-only js modules
systems.function: A planned part of the Gradle build: compile each multiplatform module's commonMain for js so a JVM API in common code is a compile error, without publishing anything.

systems.name: webtools-http
systems.function: A Kotlin Multiplatform suspend HTTP stack: transport, outbound-URL policies, response cache, call budget, call facades, failure model and published test fixtures.

systems.name: webtools-http common core
systems.function: Own the vocabulary every other part of the stack speaks: the opt-in marker, the failure model, request and response types, the transport and wall-clock ports, the logging seam.

systems.name: published test fixtures
systems.function: Let a consumer test its providers with no network at Level 2 and over loopback at Level 3, through the webtools-http test-fixtures variant.

systems.name: outbound-URL policy
systems.function: Decide, for every hop and every resolved address, whether a fetch may proceed, from data parameters that can only tighten.

systems.name: OkHttp transport
systems.function: Deliver one request per hop to the network, read a capped body where cancellation can reach it, and map every outcome to the failure model.

systems.name: response cache
systems.function: Serve one decoded value per key to many concurrent callers from one load, for a bounded time, never caching a failure.

systems.name: call budget
systems.function: Grant permits under a provider's clock-aligned windows and lane shares, pause on server signals, and hold a hard daily stop.

systems.name: call facades
systems.function: Compose cache, budget and transport into UpstreamClient (endpoints) and UrlFetcher (administrator-supplied URLs), and own what they built.

systems.name: webtools-feeds
systems.function: Parse RSS and Atom behind a hardened parser port with a Rome default, and fetch feeds with a caller-owned conditional GET over UrlFetcher.
